description: Removal of existing cladding (front, rear, rear side and plant room elevations) and canopy (front & rear elevations), and installation of new external wall insulation system (front, rear, rear side, and plant room elevations), together with replacement windows, AOV compliance works and other associated works.
application_type_full: Full planning & demolition in a conservation area
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The applicant will ensure that the fabric performance associated with refurbishments and renovations will adhere to those as set out by the Sustainability Statement hereby approved. This should include ensuring u values of 0.25-0.27 for external walls & 1.4 for windows for relevant areas. The applicant shall also ensure that there will be no deterioration to elements that are not integral to the work through the hereby approved development.REASON: In the interest of addressing climate change and securing sustainable and net zero development and construction, in accordance with LP54, LP55 and LP56 of the Hackney Local Plan, SI2, SI3, SI4 and SI7 of the London Plan, and Section 14 of the National Planning Policy Framework

<p>Prior to commencement of the development,&nbsp; the applicant shall provide a suitably adequate construction and waste management plan. This will address reuse, recycling, and responsible disposal of materials and assets being removed from the building as part of development works, as well as addressing the sustainable specification of new materials and products as part of the development, prioritising supporting the circular economy and sustainable material procurement in new construction. This should address how relevant targets are being met or exceeded and how relevant local policy is being complied with.</p><p>REASON:&nbsp;In the interest of addressing climate change and securing sustainable and net zero development and construction, in accordance with LP54, LP55 and LP56 of the Hackney Local Plan, SI2, SI3, SI4 and SI7 of the London Plan, and Section 14 of the National Planning Policy Framework</p>

<p>Prior to reaching the above-ground works stage of the development hereby approved, a revised Sustainability &amp; Energy Strategy shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority, providing full details to demonstrate carbon savings being attained through the development, including via renovations and refurbishments.&nbsp;This should also consider longer term potential for&nbsp;further&nbsp;retrofit towards climate resilience and decarbonisation of the building,&nbsp;and anticipate any enabling works required for incorporating renewable energy systems in the future.&nbsp;The operational carbon emissions shall be calculated using the appropriate methodology, following guidance as set out by the GLA Guide for Energy Assessments (version from June 2022) or other relevant best practice guidance.</p><p>REASON: In the interest of addressing climate change and securing sustainable and net zero development and construction.</p>

<p>Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved, the applicant will undertake detailed thermal modelling analysis to ensure that the designs support maximisation of passive cooling measures and support mitigation to overheating risk, in line with best practice and standard industry assessment methodologies.&nbsp;The applicant is required to ensure that the principles proposed in the hereby approved strategies are delivered and perform as expected as a minimum, and ideally improved upon:&nbsp;</p><p>a. Low g-value glazing (0.40-0.50)</p><p>b. Secure night vents</p><p>c. 30 openable window areas</p><p>d. Projecting areas of surround to windows for solar shading.</p><p>REASON: In the interest of supporting climate resilience (LP54), net zero (LP55) and healthy places (LP9)</p>
